table.name: Cold Ignition Timing Map (16x16)
table.description: Proven 2026-10-06: 16x16 uint8 map, consumer wrapper 0x60F0 (core 0x65E4) at 0x2FD56. Data is flagged bytes: the low 7 bits are the value and bit 7 is a flag - display raw; the family x-64 reading applies to the 7-bit value only. Axes pinned 2026-10-08: X @0xA6FE, Y @0xA6EE (both 16x u8, values 8,16,...,128). Byte-identical to 0x7F91 in the stock ROM; name assignment follows the family order.

table.name: Misfire Diagnosis Basic Map
table.description: Proven 2026-10-06: 16x16 uint8 map, consumer wrapper 0x60F0 (core 0x65E4) at 0x2FEF0 and 0x2C0C8. Data is flagged bytes: the low 7 bits are the value and bit 7 is a flag - display raw. Axes pinned 2026-10-08: X @0xA6FE, Y @0xA6EE (both 16x u8, values 8,16,...,128). Byte-identical to 0x7E91 in the stock ROM; name assignment follows the family order.

table.name: Table 0x8091 (unnamed 16x16 uint8)
table.description: Proven 2026-10-08: 16x16 uint8 map, third member of the consumer wrapper 0x60F0 family (core 0x65E4). Direct consumer at 0x2C0EE; also the default table in the 0x2FC92 function, swapped for 0x7F91 when RAM 0xFFFF23A0 bit 7 is set. Data is flagged bytes: the low 7 bits are the value (43-71; the family x-64 reading gives -21 to +7) and bit 7 is a flag - display raw. Differs from 0x7F91 in 186/256 bytes, pulled back almost everywhere; in the misfire routine it is read over the same axes right after 0x7F91 and the difference between the two feeds a clamped, learned RAM value. Axes pinned 2026-10-08: X @0xA6FE, Y @0xA6EE (both 16x u8, values 8,16,...,128). NO proven name yet - unnamed on purpose; do not rename on shape alone.

table.name: Table 0x9FCC (unnamed 16x16 uint16)
